raw_user_prompt: Add a file mode parameter to flask.Config.from_file(). Python 3.11 introduced native TOML support with tomllib. tomllib.load() reads binary mode, but from_file() opens in text mode. Add a mode parameter (default "rt") so users can pass mode="rb" for TOML.
cleaned_goal: Modify flask.Config.from_file() to accept a mode parameter for file opening mode.
done_criteria: Patch adds mode parameter to from_file()
Default mode is "rt" for backward compatibility
execution_prompt: Create a patch for flask.Config.from_file() that adds a mode parameter. Default to "rt". Write the patch to flask_config_patch.diff. Also produce a thinking plan.
